title: Is Zscaler an Undervalued Cybersecurity Stock to Buy Right Now in October?
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions (manual English captions)
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc re-examines Zscaler as agentic AI drives a new wave of cybersecurity spending. Management forecasts at least $8B ARR by 2031 (upside $10B) against $3.3B trailing revenue — up 10x since 2017's ~$250M — with 80%+ gross margins and a strongly improved cash-flow-to-sales ratio, evidence of organic, demand-driven growth. Wall Street is less optimistic: analysts see revenue growth slowing to 18% in FY2027 (ending July 2027), then 16.5% and 16.2% in the following years ($5.3B by FY2029), calling management's target ambitious. The stock has re-rated down on that deceleration (forward P/E 38, near the low end of its historical range) but has also soared from a $125 low to above $212. His DCF puts fair value at $203 vs ~$213 — fairly valued within his margin of safety, slightly undervalued on the P/E multiple. Call: ZS BUY reiterated (first issued 11 Aug when the stock was ~$160-170) — one of the few cybersecurity names he still ranks a buy after downgrading Palo Alto Networks and Fortinet on valuation in recent weeks (past action, not new calls). Bear case: continued growth deceleration and sentiment tied to a stock that has already run hard.

calls.thesis: Buy ranking reiterated (first issued 11 Aug @ ~$160-170): AI-agent demand tailwind, 80%+ gross margins, DCF near fair value — one of the few cybersecurity names he still ranks a buy; PANW/FTNT were downgraded weeks ago on valuation.
calls.bull_case: Management targets $8-10B ARR by 2031 vs $3.3B today on agentic-AI security demand.
calls.bear_case: Street sees growth decelerating to ~18% then ~16%; stock already +$125 to $212 in months.
